translations.builders-page.hero.lede: Idem Builders shows the projects that put Africa forward and that run on IDEM. Your project gets seen, and keeping it alive costs you less.
translations.builders-page.condition.title: One condition: run it with IDEM
translations.builders-page.condition.body: The programme is for projects that live on IDEM, not only projects that started there. One of these three is enough, and IDEM checks it for you when you apply.
translations.builders-page.condition.africa: Then the team looks at what the project brings to Africa: the people it serves, the problem it solves, where it is built.
translations.builders-page.way.deploy.title: Put it online with iDeploy
translations.builders-page.way.deploy.description: Your website or app runs on IDEM hosting, published from iCode or from your own code.
translations.builders-page.way.communication.title: Manage its marketing in IDEM
translations.builders-page.way.communication.descript: Your strategy, calendar, visuals or videos are prepared and published from IDEM.
translations.builders-page.way.domain.title: Register its domain with IDEM
translations.builders-page.way.domain.description: Its address on the web was bought and is renewed through IDEM.
translations.builders-page.perks.title: What you get
translations.builders-page.perks.lede: Visibility, and lower costs on what you already use. Applied automatically from the day you are accepted.
translations.builders-page.perk.showcase.title: A place in the showcase
translations.builders-page.perk.badge.title: The Idem Builder badge
translations.builders-page.steps.title: How to join
translations.builders-page.steps.body: Everything happens in your IDEM console. It takes a few minutes.
translations.builders-page.step.account.title: Sign in to IDEM
translations.builders-page.step.account.description: Create your account if you do not have one yet. It is free.
translations.builders-page.step.project.title: Pick your project
translations.builders-page.step.project.description: IDEM shows you right away whether it is run with IDEM, and what to do if it is not yet.
translations.builders-page.step.pitch.title: Tell us how it puts Africa forward
translations.builders-page.step.pitch.description: The problem you solve, for whom, where. A few lines are enough; this is what the team reads.
translations.builders-page.step.answer.title: Get the answer by email
translations.builders-page.step.answer.description: A person from the team reviews every application, within {$days} working days. Accepted, your benefits are active at once.
translations.builders-page.showcase.title: The builders
translations.builders-page.showcase.error: The showcase could not be loaded.
translations.builders-page.faq.title: Questions
translations.builders-page.faq.legal: The full rules are in the participation terms and the programme privacy policy, which you accept before applying.
translations.builders-page.faq.free.question: Does it cost anything?
translations.builders-page.faq.free.answer: No. Joining is free and does not oblige you to buy anything. The benefits apply to what you already use.
translations.builders-page.faq.several.question: Can I submit several projects?
translations.builders-page.faq.several.answer: Yes, one application per project. The welcome bonus is paid once per account; the other benefits apply to the whole account.
translations.builders-page.faq.refused.question: What if my application is not accepted?
translations.builders-page.faq.refused.answer: You receive the reason by email. Once the project has changed, you can apply again.
translations.builders-page.faq.leave.question: Can I leave the programme?
translations.builders-page.faq.leave.answer: At any time, by writing to us. You can also ask to hide your project from the showcase and stay a member.
translations.builders-page.cta.body: Run it with IDEM, tell us what it does for Africa, and we will show it.
translations.builders-page.showcase.emptyBody: Run your project with IDEM and tell us what it does for Africa.
translations.builders-page.cta.title2: Grow it here. We will make it known.
translations.builders-page.benefit.welcome.title: {$amount} F when you are accepted
translations.builders-page.benefit.welcome.body: Paid into your wallet once per account, for any IDEM service.
translations.builders-page.benefit.topup.title: +{$percent}% on every top-up
translations.builders-page.benefit.topup.body: Added on top of the tier bonus, for as long as you are a member.
translations.builders-page.benefit.hosting.title: -{$percent}% on hosting
translations.builders-page.benefit.hosting.body: The daily price of your iDeploy meters drops, for sites and apps alike.
translations.builders-page.benefit.showcase.body: Your project on idem.africa/builders, with its country and a link to it.
translations.builders-page.benefit.portrait.title: A feature by the team
translations.builders-page.benefit.portrait.body: Selected projects are told on the IDEM blog and social channels, prepared with you.
translations.builders-page.benefit.badge.body: For your own site: it shows you belong and links back here.
translations.builders-page.proof.badge: Your badge, ready to paste on your site
translations.builders-page.showcase.previewTagline: One sentence on what it does, and for whom.
